items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: Well we had this little band at the Colonial Country Club out there. We played out there... Metry, played

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. That's where they had Robichur's band, wasn't it? They had a regular band there. Did you ever play any dances anyplace? That is, was this music suitable for dancing to you? I mean did you actually play for dances someplace?

Well we had this little band at the Colonial Country Club out there. We played out there, we played for the New Orleans Country Club. Metry, played, well it was in a teensy, it was a Brennan restaurant, we were in a teen, old Absent House, oh we had a lot of plays, a lot of plays.
When you played your guitar you say Walter Nelson helped you with that, taught that to you?
